purpose: Recover source metadata sufficient to freeze interaction family and focal-guild semantics before any interaction edge/type/value is opened.

focal_guild_rule.mixed_or_other: must define source-specific focal guild before admission

semantic_gate.rationale: At least eight programmes should survive source-level semantic adjudication before investing in cross-taxon phylogeny and geometry qualification; this is a development gate, not the final >=12-system inference gate.

next_gate_if_pass: Freeze programme-level interaction family/focal guild and then perform taxonomy-name/phylogeny feasibility without opening interaction edges.
next_gate_if_hold: Stop Mangal route before edge opening; consider GloBI under the finite-family source rule.
